summary: The app renders app/public/data/validation.json in the Method and checks drawer: per-check rows with counts, limits and recorded results (the page never computes a pass), mission hindcast sub-checks with references and measured values, pending rows with reasons and no invented numbers, per-quantity sources, the limits section, and reproduce commands. Real direction, skyline and hindcast results are shown.

pendingRendered.reason: no LOLA raster in data/ or data-raw/; shown as pending, not passed

recordedVsCurrentRun: The committed validation.json at the base commit records raster-orientation as pass (n=4, run 2026-11-15T00:17:21Z, generated when the gitignored rasters were still present). The regeneration on 2026-11-15T06 replaces it with a pending row, because the rasters are not in this working tree. Both states stay visible: git history keeps the recorded pass; the page shows what this tree can rerun.
